C0910.title: Construction Worker Discovers He Is Listed as Executive of Four Companies in Suspected Facial Recognition Identity Theft
C0910.summary: In March 2021, a young man working at a construction site discovered he was listed as a senior executive of four companies without his knowledge. Authorities stated that since 2020, company registration requires real-name verification but can be completed remotely.
